Quick context: Nova Analytics (Deal RDW-DEAL-4782) is moving from pilot -> paid pilot and has indicated they want dedicated capacity. We need to decide reserved units for Weeks 23–30 and whether to sign them up for a Dedicated 1-month commit or recommend a hybrid dedicated+burst approach.

Ask for this week (please reply inline by EOD Thursday):
- Sales: confirm probability-weighted commit values for Nova + any other deals you expect to speak to finance about (Karthik).
- Finance: what headroom thresholds do we have for accepting partial reservations vs. requiring a full commit (Laura).
- Infra: realistic lead time for provisioning A100/V100 or q8 quantized SKUs and associated minimum reservation sizes (Marissa).
- Ops: fallback policy for <48hr spikes (Rishi/Sojin).

Attached: reservation_matrix_v1.xlsx — fill the "sales-proposed" column. I’ll consolidate and send final to finance next Mon.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park

Thanks — a few finance constraints to be explicit about before we present to Nova:
- Minimum reservation term we can approve for pilot->paid is 30 days; any shorter is a negotiation exception.
- For deals under $50k ARR expected in first year, we prefer a hybrid commit (50% committed, 50% burst) to mitigate utilization risk.
- We can make a one-time exception for Nova if the forecasted ARR > $150k and legal signs an SLA for minimum throughput.

Please add an "expected ARR" column to the sheet and mark Nova with your best estimate. If we proceed with the 6 A100 equivalent as Karthik suggested, finance will draft an approval memo — we'll need the cost runway and expected start date.

Laura
Head of Finance

Heads-up on infra constraints and lead time:
- A100-80GB physical provisioning: ~10 business days from reservation confirmation (current queue). Minimum allocation block is 2 GPUs per reservation for Dedicated pools.
- q8-quantized instances (custom SKU): can be ready in ~4 business days but we need to validate model correctness and perf. Minimum is 4 lanes for the q8 SKU.
- If Nova needs 6 A100-equivalents, that means either: 6x A100 reserved (10d lead) OR 12x q8 lanes reserved (4d lead) depending on perf acceptance.

Operational suggestion: we should offer Nova a staged reservation — commit 3 A100-equivalents immediately, gate the remaining 3 on a successful perf validation in week+1. That reduces our near-term provisioning pressure and fits finance's preference for staged commits.

Marissa
Head of Infra Capacity Planning
